cue: Initial transistor-level topology for MCP6441 proposed by EDAI (FLAN-T5)
lesson: Start from blueprint 'EDAI_C_MCP6441': GF180MCU 6V transistor-level op-amp sized by gm/ID (ngspice pre-check 5/7 specs). Keep the .include model line; devices use nfet_06v0_bsim0 / pfet_06v0_bsim0.
